mapper.select: SELECT member_id, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class, card_next_class FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT member_id, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class FROM member WHERE member_phone = #{memberPhone}
SELECT member_id, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class FROM member

SELECT member_id, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class FROM member WHERE member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT member_id, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class FROM member ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class, card_next_class) VALUES (#{memberName}, #{memberGender}, #{memberAge}, #{memberHeight}, #{memberWeight}, #{memberPhone}, #{cardTime}, #{cardClass}, #{cardNextClass})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_name = #{memberName}, member_gender = #{memberGender}, member_age = #{memberAge}, member_height = #{memberHeight}, member_weight = #{memberWeight}, member_phone = #{memberPhone}, card_time = #{cardTime}, card_class = #{cardClass}, card_next_class = #{cardNextClass} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
